about_the_game:
Fill boss battles with roaring electric guitars and energetic drums with the Battle Scene Music Pack! Ayato Sound Create is back with another music pack, and this pack’s 10 BGMs are ready to add some extra oomph to your modern game’s combat, with heavy drum beats keeping your players’ heart thumping and electric guitars and basses offering up some fast-paced melodies to help your players’ focus entirely on surviving the fight. 5 different themes are different enough to keep things feeling new without totally changing the music’s genre, with 4 metalcore, 1 gothic, 1 hardcore, 2 modern, and 2 emo style tracks! Choose a track with the right rhythm for your fight, and switch to a harsher song when the enemies are stronger than your players expect or change to a lighter song to let your players know when they’ve leveled up enough that the enemies won’t give them a challenge anymore.

Don’t forget that you can use these tracks for more than just battles! Give your stealth mission a surprising soundtrack when your heroes sneak into an active concert, and clue your players into dangerous areas when they stumble into somewhere they aren’t ready to be yet. Each track comes in M4a and looping Ogg file formats, so it’s easy to use in your favorite engine. If your game has a battle in a metal club or you want your final fight to feel like even the music will thrash your heroes if your players aren’t careful, check out the Battle Scene Music Pack!

Contents:

* 10 BGM royalty free
* m4a and ogg file formats included


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
